subject: design-technology

moments.title: Learning from Las Vegas
moments.who: Robert Venturi, Denise Scott Brown, Steven Izenour
moments.body: The book argues for studying everyday commercial vernacular, opening the path to postmodern architecture.

moments.title: Memphis Group
moments.body: Sottsass launches the Memphis Group at the Salone del Mobile with brightly patterned, intentionally clashing furniture.
moments.takeaway: Modernist sobriety provoked its own colourful rebellion.

moments.title: Memphis dissolves
moments.body: After a decade-long burst of influence, the group disbands. Its visual language persists in graphic design.
moments.takeaway: Short-lived movements can have long visual afterlives.

now.title: Postmodernism now
now.body: Memphis patterns recur in fashion, tech branding and TikTok aesthetics. Postmodern buildings are now being demolished or listed.

reflection: Postmodernism made fun of modernism while still depending on it.
